reason: I like the local, upcycled, Japanese-method story and it would look great on Instagram for the summer menu, but I'd ask for the free sample first, I wouldn't order a litre blind. And it's fermented with no word on alcohol, so I can't put it on my no-alcohol menu or sort the paperwork until I know.
objection: Fermented means there might be some alcohol in it, and nobody tells me how much. For my no-alcohol cocktails and for the paperwork I need it in writing. Also 23 euros a litre is double what I pay for a classic syrup on a short list like mine.
would_change_my_mind: A technical sheet showing the alcohol level (under 0.5%), how long it keeps once opened, and a sample that tastes good enough to build a seasonal signature cocktail around it.
